sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include bleomycin sulfate as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 12 vials at 3.9 vials per day, providing 3.1 days of supply.
Corvale General holds 67 vials at 3 vials per day, providing 22.7 days of supply.
Corvale Lakeside holds 16 vials at 0.9 vials per day, providing 18.5 days of supply.
The top-ranked option is to transfer 25 vials from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would leave Corvale General with 14 days of supply and bring Corvale East to 10 days.
This transfer requires a pharmacy director transfer request.
